vetSays.line: 🛡️ Willie, Francesca, Carlos, Denis and Tatiana met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Willie, Francesca, Carlos, Tatiana are hurt.
🛡️ Francesca, Carlos, Denis and Tatiana met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Francesca, Carlos, Tatiana are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Carlos, Denis, Fatima and Thabo met them at the door — 4 put down. Carlos, Denis, Fatima, Thabo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Denis just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Denis just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
Zoe sees The Influencer and gives it room — not ready alone, going back for help.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoe just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Daniel and Zoe met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Daniel, Zoe are hurt.
Somchai sees The Strike and gives it room — not ready alone, going back for help.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hannah just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hannah just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Daniel, Hannah, Sari and Amina met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Daniel, Hannah, Sari, Amina are hurt.
